assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias.
There is a need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities.
The service supports the documented diagnoses of I48.91 and I49.5.
The indication note confirms the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
